from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator

from .candidate_datapoint import CandidateDatapointSkeleton
from .task import TaskConfiguration, TaskState


class PayInformation(BaseModel):
    """Pay information for a job position."""

    range: dict[str, float] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="Pay range with min and max values")
    currency: str = Field(default="USD", description="Currency code for the pay information")
    frequency: Literal["hourly", "daily", "weekly", "monthly", "yearly"] | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Frequency of pay (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly)"
    )

    @field_validator("range")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pay_range(cls, v: dict[str, float]) -> dict[str, float]:
        if v and "min" in v and "max" in v:
            if v["min"] > v["max"]:
                raise ValueError("Minimum pay cannot be greater than maximum pay")
        return v

from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from .candidate_datapoint import CandidateDatapointDefinition
from .task_agent import TaskAgentType


class TaskAgentFeedbackStatus(StrEnum):
    COMPLETED = "COMPLETED"
    SET_BACK = "SET_BACK"


class TaskValidationType(StrEnum):
    # validation using query against data point (leveraging jsonata) - e.g years_experience > 5 && years_experience < 10
    DATAPOINT_QUERY = "DATAPOINT_QUERY"
    # For future reference, natural language validation - e.g "candidates have some experience in management a small to medium team"
    # This will introduce significant latency so skipping for now
    # AI_QUERY = "AI_QUERY"


class TaskFailureBehavior(StrEnum):
    # Re-try agent
    RETRY = "RETRY"
    # Move to next task
    SKIP = "SKIP"
    # End the call
    END_CALL = "END_CALL"


class TaskSuccessStrategy(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for handling successful completion of a task."""

    description: str = Field(description="Description of what constitutes success for this task")


class TaskFailureStrategy(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for handling failed completion of a task."""

    failure_reason: str = Field(description="Reason why this task failed")


class TaskFailureRetryStrategy(TaskFailureStrategy):
    """Configuration for handling retry of a task."""

    behavior: Literal[TaskFailureBehavior.RETRY] = Field(
        default=TaskFailureBehavior.RETRY, description="Behavior to retry the agent"
    )
    max_attempts: int = Field(description="Maximum number of retry attempts allowed")


class TaskFailureSkipStrategy(TaskFailureStrategy):
    """Configuration for handling skipping of a task."""

    behavior: Literal[TaskFailureBehavior.SKIP] = Field(
        default=TaskFailureBehavior.SKIP, description="Behavior to skip to next task"
    )
    # proceed with next task if none provided
    next_task_id: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="ID of the next task to execute after skipping, if none provided proceeds with default next task",
    )


class TaskFailureEndCallStrategy(TaskFailureStrategy):
    """Configuration for handling skipping of a task."""

    behavior: Literal[TaskFailureBehavior.END_CALL] = Field(
        default=TaskFailureBehavior.END_CALL, description="Behavior to end the call"
    )


class TaskDatapointQueryValidationStrategy(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for handling validation of a task."""

    strategy: Literal[TaskValidationType.DATAPOINT_QUERY] = Field(
        default=TaskValidationType.DATAPOINT_QUERY, description="Type of validation strategy to use"
    )
    query: str = Field(description="JSONata query string for validating datapoints")
    instructions_on_failure: str = Field(description="Instructions for the agent to follow")


class BaseTaskConfiguration(BaseModel):
    """General Task Configuration"""

    id: str = Field(description="Unique identifier for this call task")
    title: str = Field(description="Human-readable title for this task")
    description: str = Field(description="Detailed description of what this task does")
    initial_message: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Optional initial message to send when entering this task"
    )
    task_instructions: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Optional specific instructions for the agent processing this task"
    )

    # Configuration for handling successful completion of a task.
    # If none provided, this is a terminal task.
    on_success: TaskSuccessStrategy | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Configuration for handling successful completion of a task. If none provided, this is a terminal task",
    )

    # Configuration for handling failed completion of a task.
    # If no failure_handling is provided, default to skipping
    failure_handling: list[TaskFailureEndCallStrategy | TaskFailureRetryStrategy | TaskFailureSkipStrategy] = Field(
        default=[],
        description="Configuration for handling failed completion of a task. If no failure_handling is provided, default to skipping",
    )

    # Configuration for handling pre-requisites of a task.
    # All pre-requisites must be satisfied before we can process this task
    # pre-requisites are checked against existing candidate profile
    pre_requisites: list[TaskDatapointQueryValidationStrategy] = Field(
        default=[],
        description="Configuration for handling pre-requisites of a task. All pre-requisites must be satisfied before we can process this task. Pre-requisites are checked against existing candidate profile",
    )


class GreeterTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Greeter Task"""

    agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.GREETING] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.GREETING, description="Type of agent that will handle this greeting task"
    )


class InformationTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Information Task"""

    agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.INFORMATION] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.INFORMATION, description="Type of agent that will handle this information task"
    )


class CloserTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Closer Task"""

    agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.CLOSER] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.CLOSER, description="Type of agent that will handle this closer task"
    )


class QualifierTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Qualifier Task"""

    agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.QUALIFIER] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.QUALIFIER, description="Type of agent that will handle this qualifier task"
    )

    datapoints_to_collect: list[CandidateDatapointDefinition] = Field(
        description="List of datapoints to collect from the agent",
    )

    # Configuration for handling post-requisites of a task.
    # All post-requisites must be satisfied after we have processed task
    # post-requisites are checked against ONLY output datapoint from this task
    post_requisites: list[TaskDatapointQueryValidationStrategy] = Field(
        default=[],
        description="Configuration for handling post-requisites of a task. All post-requisites must be satisfied after we have processed task. Post-requisites are checked against ONLY output datapoint from this task",
    )


TaskConfiguration = (
    GreeterTaskConfiguration | InformationTaskConfiguration | QualifierTaskConfiguration | CloserTaskConfiguration
)


class TaskAgentFeedback(BaseModel):
    """[INTERNAL] Feedback from an agent as it is processing a task"""

    status: TaskAgentFeedbackStatus = Field(description="Status of the agent feedback")
    feedback: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Optional feedback message from the agent")


class TaskState(BaseModel):
    """[INTERNAL] Living State of a call task"""

    call_task_id: str = Field(description="ID of the call task this state represents")
    collected_datapoints: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default={}, description="Dictionary of datapoints collected during task processing"
    )
    collected_signals: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default={}, description="Dictionary of signals collected during task processing"
    )
    notes: list[str] = Field(default=[], description="List of notes generated during task processing")

    is_completed: bool = Field(default=False, description="Whether this task has completed processing")
    outstanding_agent_feedback: TaskAgentFeedback | None = Field(
        default=None, description="unresolved feedback from the agent processing this task"
    )
